verdict.rationale:
TaxJar exposes a REST API with endpoints like nexusRegions, createOrder, and rate lookups, and account-level nexus threshold tracking is documented in the dashboard, giving some machine-readable access to nexus status and tax actions. However, there is no evidence of an API surface for registrations, accrued liability, or upcoming filings, no scoped/least-privilege credentials (only a single bearer API token per docs-11), and no MCP server or OpenAPI spec (probes show llms.txt and OpenAPI endpoints 404).

missing for 10: scoped/granular API credentials, API endpoints for registrations/accrued liability/upcoming filings, and an MCP surface or discoverable OpenAPI schema.
